title: Grandpa's Famous Pancakes
text:
Grandpa makes pancakes every Sunday morning. He says this recipe has been in our family for {number} years. Here is how he does it.

First, put two cups of flour in a big {adjective} bowl. Add one egg, a cup of milk, and a handful of {plural noun}. Stir it {adverb} with a wooden spoon until it looks smooth.

Next, Grandpa pours the batter into the pan in the shape of a {noun}. He always lets me choose which shape comes next. Last week one pancake {past tense verb} right off the plate and landed on the dog.

We put syrup and fresh {plural noun} on top. Grandpa likes to eat his while {verb ending in ing} in his big green chair. Grandma says his pancakes taste like {food}, and Grandpa says that is the nicest thing anyone has ever told him.

title: Thank You for the Cookie Recipe
text:

text:

title: How to Set the Table
text:

Step one: Put a {adjective} placemat in front of every chair. Ours have pictures of {plural noun} on them.

Step two: Put a plate in the middle of each placemat. Make sure the plates are not upside down, or the food will {verb} right off.

Step four: Fill each cup with water, milk, or {food}. Carry the cups {adverb} so nothing spills.
